name: WHEN THE FOG COMES
desc:
WHEN THE FOG COMES is currently in BETA and is actively being tested.

Please report any bugs, issues, or feedback you encounter — every report helps improve the game.

Explore a ruined world where valuable furniture and forgotten objects are buried beneath the remains of civilization. Dig up items, unlock everything in the Catalog, and use your discoveries to furnish and personalize your own private space.

But be careful — the fog is dangerous. Hidden threats lurk inside it, waiting for careless explorers. A gas mask will allow you to survive longer in the fog, but it will not protect you from everything that hides within.

Search, collect, unlock, decorate, and survive… when the fog comes.
